tested_on: The code is the previous version plus a change to the error text in Run diagnostic; the plugin's tests and a new test that checks the report for server addresses pass. The previous version was lab-tested on the real software.
reviews.notes: Patch release made with the assistant Claude and confirmed by the maintainer: only the error text of Run diagnostic changed. Reviewed, not re-tested on the real software.

Written and lab-tested on 2026-10-16 with the assistant Claude, confirmed by the maintainer. Tested only against the govmomi simulator vcsim (vCenter 6.5 API); no real ESXi or vCenter was available, so it is not marked verified. Read-only SOAP calls, logs out at the end. VMware Tools addresses and host management addresses follow the API documentation.
